text:
lee (partnerships): Quick kickoff for Marvell EAP -> need to lock NDA, shipping terms, and the minimal benchmark matrix. Prefer to keep this thread for logistics + run notes.

ana (marvell): Hi all  NDA draft uploaded to the drive (link: https://drive.redwood/Marvell-NDA). We can ship two eval SKUs (M1-lite, M1-pro). Shipping options: DDP or EXW. Which do you prefer? Also share customs HS code and importer EIN to avoid delays.

tom (eng-ml): We prefer DDP if Marvell can handle duties. Benchmark idea: 1) Single-stream latency at seq=2048, batch=1 & report p50/p95/p99; 2) Sustained throughput with batch=4/8 for 15 minutes; 3) KV-cache long-context run at 65k tokens to validate token continuity. Use model tag rdx-7b-fp16 and run three repeats for each vector.

vince (eng-runtime): On the runtime side we need: kernel headers (if modules), device node creation steps, and any special udev rules. Also request a small telemetry shim that emits latency histograms + power samples to stdout. Example start command well run:
```
./start_adapter --model rdx-7b-fp16 --port 9000 --enable-kv --max-batch 8
```
Please confirm adapter will expose a gRPC endpoint compatible with our client.

ana (marvell): Adapter will be gRPC compatible. Firmware image: marvell-ml-fw-2.4. HS code we recommend is 8471.80.6100. We can do DDP but need Redwood EIN for paperwork. Will include power telemetry and perf counters in the adapter.

emily (legal): I glanced at the NDA. Two items: 1) export controls clause needs explicit adherence to US/EU lists (we can accept but add an exceptions paragraph); 2) data retention period for logs should be defined (30 days preferred). Ana  can Marvell accept those edits?

ana (marvell): Export control paragraph ok, retention 30 days is fine. We'll sign when we receive exec-signed copy.

olga (product): Heads-up: embargo until marketing and partners approve joint communications. We'll prep a one-pager and a quick internal brief for AUG-ops. Also capture qualitative notes: jitter, tail-latency spikes, infra quirks.

tom (eng-ml): For reproducibility: please provide adapter image digest, firmware checksum, and sample input prompts we used. We'll store raw outputs and diffs. Our bench script will output a JSON summary and raw token traces. Example run: 
```
./bench_runner --model rdx-7b-fp16 --seq 2048 --batch 1 --out out_latency.json
```
We'll include a small script to verify no token drift when enabling batching/fusions.

vince (eng-runtime): Also add CI integration possibility: if hardware passes baseline, we can add an automated weekly regression job that pings the adapter and runs a tiny smoke test. Will need a stable IP or VPN endpoint.

marvell-shipping-bot: Shipment created: MV-2401. ETA label printed 2026-04-05. Tracking will update once handed to carrier.

lee (partnerships): Proposed timeline: NDA sign today -> Marvell ships DDP 2026-04-05 -> Redwood bench 2026-04-06/07 -> internal feedback by 2026-04-09 -> decision on extended program by 2026-04-12. If anyone has blockers speak up now.

emily (legal): I'll incorporate the two small edits and return the signed NDA this afternoon.

ana (marvell): On shipping: we'll attach a preflight tarball with adapter OCI image, firmware checksums, `run_validation.sh`, and a simple README. Will share tracking ASAP.

vince (eng-runtime): Please include sample `/dev` nodes and exact udev rules in the tarball, and any special capabilities needed for the container runtime (CAP_SYS_ADMIN? CAP_NET_RAW?).

tom (eng-ml): Add perf counters we want: tokens/sec, latency_histogram (buckets), power_watts sample. Also please include timestamps in UTC in logs.

olga (product): Action: I'll draft the embargo template + one-pager and post here for comment. No external comms until signoff.

lee (partnerships): Action items: 1) Emily finalize & return NDA (Emily). 2) Ana upload preflight tarball + shipping details (Ana). 3) Vince prepare runtime image and CI stub (Vince). 4) Tom prepare bench harness and token-drift checks (Tom). 5) Olga draft comms template (Olga). We'll reconvene once tracking is posted. :rocket:

ana (marvell): Thanks all. We'll aim to have tarball and signed NDA by EOD.
